turns.speaker: Steve
turns.text: As a professor, I'd rephrase that statement to better reflect the hard work and dedication that goes into achieving success. For example, "Wow, you've really outdone yourself on that test! It shows how much effort you've put in, and I'm impressed. Anyone can have a good day, but consistently performing well requires dedication and smart work." In psychology, we call this growth mindset, where people believe that abilities can be developed through dedication and hard work.
